description:
Flood Control, Mississippi River and Tributaries, Indefinite Delivery – Indefinite Quantity Contract, 2026 Stone Placement, Mississippi, Atchafalaya, and Red Rivers, and Old River Control Channels (ED 26-026).

NOTE:  THIS IS A SYNOPSIS, NOT A SOLICITATION. PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS ARE NOT AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME; THEREFORE, NO QUESTIONS OF A TECHNICAL OR CONTRACTUAL NATURE WILL BE ACCEPTED OR ANSWERED. INFORMATION CONTAINED IN THIS SYNOPSIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE.

This is an UNRESTRICTED procurement. NAICS Code is 237990.  The solicitation, W912P826BA024, is anticipated to issue as an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The resulting contract shall be a Firm Fixed-Price (FFP) procurement. The solicitation will be issued on or about May 22, 2026, and a bid opening date will be on or about June 22, 2026. 

Description of Work:

The work consists of various types of stone placement along the banks of the Mississippi River (Miles 325.8 to 0.0 AHP), Atchafalaya River (Miles 0.0 to 137.0), Red River (Miles 6.0 to 11.0), and Old River Control Channels. (The estimated time of completion not to exceed 730 calendar days after receipt of notice to proceed.)

The estimated magnitude of construction for this work is between $10,000,000 and $25,000,000. All qualified business concerns may submit bids. Please note, bids received from large business firms must comply with RFO 19.206 and RFO 52.219-9 regarding the requirement for submission of a subcontracting plan.

The solicitation documents for this procurement will be posted on SAM (www.sam.gov).  You will need the adobe acrobat reader for .pdf files (www.adobe.com) in order to open most files posted by the New Orleans District.  You are encouraged, for marketing purposes, to register as an Interested Vendor in System for Award Management (SAM) (www.sam.gov).  This can be done by clicking on the solicitation title and clicking on the button that says Register as an Interested Vendor and entering your business information.  At the time of bid submission, all bidders MUST be registered on SAM.gov under NAICS code 237990 to be considered for award. Bidders must be registered with the (SAM), in order to receive a Government contract award. To register, the SAM Internet address is: http://www.sam.gov. If your company is not registered in SAM you may do so by going to: http://www.sam.gov. You may be required to provide your company's unique entity identifier (UEI) issued by the GSA. If you do not have a UEI, one can be obtained by calling (866) 606-8220 or by going to: http://www.sam.gov.

The Contract Specialist for this solicitation is Anedra Baldwin, who may be reached via e-mail at Anedra.A.Baldwin@usace.army.mil.  The Contracting Officer for this solicitation is Karen Hargrave, who may be reached via email at Karen.D.Hargrave@usace.army.mil.
